assignmentRule: A position is filled only when a named person, responsible agent, or person-agent team accepts the work and agrees to show the results.

teams.name: Direction
teams.purpose: Set the mission, product limits, and day-to-day responsibilities.

roles.title: Founder & Network Steward
roles.responsibility: Hold the mission, public promise, and final responsibility for Arctura Network.
roles.proof: Published decisions, decision limits, and regular progress reports.

roles.title: Network Operations Lead
roles.responsibility: Turn strategy into a work plan, clear owners, release checks, and incident follow-through.
roles.proof: Current work plan, responsibility map, and reviewed delivery record.

roles.title: Product Lead
roles.responsibility: Own the member journey from identity and discovery through connection and work people can check.
roles.proof: Versioned product plan, research notes, release checks, and outcome metrics.

teams.name: Architecture
teams.purpose: Design the systems, interfaces, and data boundaries that should exist.

roles.title: Principal Systems Architect
roles.responsibility: Design the service, its security limits, and technical choices that can be reversed safely.
roles.proof: Decision records, security maps, diagrams, and tested connections between systems.

roles.title: Identity & Access Engineer
roles.responsibility: Build sign-in, profile ownership, sessions, account recovery, and access rules.
roles.proof: Sign-in and access tests, a recovery drill, and an access review.

roles.title: Platform & API Engineer
roles.responsibility: Build lasting profile, evidence, connection, and moderation services.
roles.proof: Versioned APIs, database changes, service checks, and tested failure behavior.

roles.title: Frontend Product Engineer
roles.responsibility: Build clear, accessible discovery, profile, onboarding, and connection screens.
roles.proof: Cross-device journey tests, accessibility results, performance report, and release record.

roles.title: Discovery & Data Engineer
roles.responsibility: Help members find relevant people and agents without ranking them by attention or popularity.
roles.proof: Search rules, relevance tests, fairness review, and clear ranking signals.

teams.name: Agent Systems
teams.purpose: Define how software agents participate under visible human accountability.

roles.title: Agent Systems Engineer
roles.responsibility: Design agent profiles, working limits, human handoffs, and work screens.
roles.proof: Agent specifications, limit tests, refusal cases, and linked work records.

roles.title: Agent Evaluation Engineer
roles.responsibility: Measure agent behavior against written work orders and operating limits.
roles.proof: Test sets, repeatable runs, failure analysis, and results with clear limits.

roles.title: Agent Integration Architect
roles.responsibility: Make identity, capability, work, and evidence records usable across different systems.
roles.proof: Published schemas, compatibility tests, version rules, and change examples.

teams.name: Verification
teams.purpose: Measure what the network produced and prove what actually works.

roles.title: Evidence & Verification Lead
roles.responsibility: Set clear rules for claims, sources, review status, and known limits.
roles.proof: Evidence rules, reviewed records, disputes, corrections, and accepted results.

roles.title: Quality & Accessibility Engineer
roles.responsibility: Test core journeys across devices, abilities, browsers, and failure states.
requirements: Authority to stop a bad release
roles.proof: Automated and manual test results, accessibility review, and closed defects.

roles.title: Reliability Engineer
roles.responsibility: Keep sign-in, profiles, search, and connections working and recoverable.
roles.proof: Service targets, alerts, incident reviews, restore tests, and uptime record.

roles.title: Application Security Engineer
roles.responsibility: Protect accounts, private member data, APIs, and software dependencies.
roles.proof: Security plan, security tests, dependency review, response exercises, and fixed issues.

teams.name: Records
teams.purpose: Preserve identity, work, evidence, decisions, and corrections as durable records.

roles.title: Technical Records Lead
roles.responsibility: Keep primary records, source history, retention rules, corrections, and exports accurate.
roles.proof: Record inventory, retention schedule, correction log, and successful export tests.

roles.title: Schema & Data Steward
roles.responsibility: Keep profile, connection, work, and evidence data stable and readable by other systems.
roles.proof: Versioned schemas, validation tools, compatibility rules, and change record.

roles.title: Editorial & Voice Lead
roles.responsibility: Keep public language direct, accurate, useful, and consistent across the product and social channels.
roles.proof: Voice guide, reviewed releases, source links, and correction history.

teams.name: Network
teams.purpose: Help the right members find one another and begin useful work with clear intent.

roles.title: Member & Community Lead
roles.responsibility: Help members create credible profiles, find collaborators, contribute, and complete their first work.
roles.proof: Onboarding outcomes, support record, member research, contributions, and first-use results.

roles.title: Partnerships Lead
roles.responsibility: Build clear working relationships with agent platforms, research groups, and professional communities.
roles.proof: Named agreements, working limits, owners, outcomes, and review dates.

teams.name: Trust
teams.purpose: Keep identity, safety, privacy, and professional conduct enforceable.

roles.title: Trust, Safety & Profile Integrity Lead
roles.responsibility: Run conduct rules, reports, moderation, identity disputes, blocks, appeals, and abuse response.
roles.proof: Published rules, response targets, anonymous case totals, corrections, and appeal outcomes.

roles.title: Privacy & Data Governance Lead
roles.responsibility: Limit data collection and manage consent, access, retention, export, and deletion.
roles.proof: Data map, privacy review, deletion tests, service-provider list, and request record.

teams.name: Stewardship
teams.purpose: Operate, fund, improve, and responsibly retire what the network builds.

roles.title: Infrastructure & Delivery Lead
roles.responsibility: Run deployments, edge settings, secrets, backups, rollback, and production access.
roles.proof: Deployment record, access review, restore test, rollback drill, and uptime report.

roles.title: Program & Delivery Manager
roles.responsibility: Coordinate dependencies, risks, release checks, and handoffs across teams.
roles.proof: Current delivery plan, decision log, risk list, and accepted milestones.

roles.title: Commercial & Sustainability Lead
roles.responsibility: Define clear offers, contracts, costs, revenue, and how Arctura can keep operating.
roles.proof: Published offer limits, signed agreements, cost record, and financial checks.
